plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Yamaha switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, chassis temperature, fan module status, power module status, and interface traffic, for SWX/SWR/SWP-series (enterprise PEN 1182).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the one-minute average CPU utilization of the Yamaha switch (yshCpuUtil1min scalar) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, loops, or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports main memory utilization of the Yamaha switch (yshMemoryUtil scalar) as a 0-100 percentage. High memory usage may indicate leaks or insufficient capacity.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the in-box temperature of the Yamaha switch in degrees Celsius (yshInboxTemperature scalar). High temperatures can indicate fan failure or airflow obstruction and risk thermal shutdown.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the state of each fan module of the Yamaha switch (yshFanModuleStatus, raw good(1) / noGood(2)), normalized so that 1 = healthy and 2 = fault.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the state of each power module of the Yamaha switch (yshPowerModuleStatus, raw up(1) / down(2) / notInstalled(3)), normalized so that 1 = healthy and 2 = fault. Empty slots (notInstalled) are dropped and not counted as faults.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
